comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: It's a very useful trade good to bribe the town officials to open up trading in the EA nations. In fact if you can't or don't want to haul a ton of goods from Europe, you can buy chickens in nearby Malacca (just one or two days sailing time northwest of Jakarta) and pluck them for feathers using R 1 sewing.

comments.author: George
comments.body: Sells for about 1,000 ducats in SE asia.
